method: Compile all three lesson Python fences. Run the selection scorer against visible/incomplete/multiple/unanswerable fixtures; AST-extract route/tools_for and test valid, unknown and list-valued groups; AST-extract usage/coverage helpers to check separate counters, malformed usage rejection, probe preflight, request-budget ordering and total-input-difference helper validation. Static assertions validate historical boundaries and provider source registration. No real API request is made.

observations.model: offline Python AST-extracted scorer and source assertions

limitations: The 2026-10-08 request and response traces, exact endpoint identifier, per-probe mapping, cache usage fields and historical scorer are unavailable; displayed figures remain non-reproducible historical summaries.

No live provider was called, so this does not validate current billing, cache behavior, latency, real tool-search/programmatic-calling behavior, model quality or the historical observations. The synthetic 4/8/16-tool fixture is only a code-path demonstration, not a representative selection benchmark.
The Anthropic tool-search and prompt-caching claims apply only to the documented Anthropic capabilities and are not a cross-provider guarantee.
